content.text: Before any real work: confirm entire.io is capturing this session. Run entire status, then make a tiny commit (add a .gitkeep under interviews/), and show me git log -1 and entire checkpoint list so I can see the Entire-Checkpoint trailer and a new checkpoint.

目前用 Opus 5.5 (medium)，這個小檢查用這個設定就夠了，不用切換。

先跑 `entire status`，也看一下 `interviews/` 在不在。

input.command: entire status; echo "---"; ls -la interviews 2>&1; echo "---"; entire checkpoint list 2>&1 | head -20
input.description: Check entire status and existing checkpoints

mkdir -p interviews && touch interviews/.gitkeep && git add interviews/.gitkeep && git commit -q -m "Add interviews directory placeholder
